title: [Keyboard Manager] Cannot remap digit row keys on French AZERTY keyboard

status.label: Verify shifted AZERTY key remapping
status.detail: PowerToys 0.97.2 restored the AltGr output for the AZERTY digit-row key, but Shift still reportedly sends the remapped curly apostrophe instead of 4.

judgment.rationale: The French AZERTY report describes a specific digit-row key whose base remap to curly apostrophe overrides the expected Shift+key output of 4. The reporter later confirmed a partial improvement on PowerToys 0.97.2: AltGr again produces an opening brace, but Shift still produces the remapped apostrophe and a Shift+key override has no effect. The reporter also confirmed ZoomIt was disabled, so the symptom should not be attributed to ZoomIt.
evidence: The issue reports PowerToys 0.94.1 on a French AZERTY layout and identifies the fifth digit-row key.
The expected layout behavior is base apostrophe, Shift+key produces 4, and AltGr+key produces an opening brace.
After remapping the base key to curly apostrophe, the issue says the Shift and AltGr outputs are overridden.
On PowerToys 0.97.2, the reporter says AltGr works again but Shift still produces curly apostrophe and a Shift+key override has no effect.
The reporter confirmed ZoomIt was disabled; the issue remains with ZoomIt off.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the residual Shift+AZERTY failure on current stable and ensure the base key remap does not override the distinct shifted digit output.

fix_assessment.rationale: The 0.97.2 update restored the AltGr output but left the shifted digit remap broken. Keyboard Manager should preserve the layout's Shift+key output or apply an explicit Shift+key mapping rather than reusing the base-key output.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve shifted outputs for AZERTY digit-row remaps
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The base-key remap may be applied to the virtual key without preserving the AZERTY layout's modifier-dependent Shift output, causing Shift+the same physical key to produce the base remapped character.
plan: Reproduce the 5th AZERTY digit-row key remap to curly apostrophe on current stable and record base, Shift, and AltGr outputs.
Trace how Keyboard Manager resolves the source virtual key and modifier state for this AZERTY key.
Update mapping resolution so the base remap does not erase the layout's shifted 4 output and explicit Shift remaps are honored.
Add regression tests for the base, Shift, and AltGr variants on French AZERTY.
verification: The base key produces the configured curly apostrophe.
Shift+the key produces 4 unless the user explicitly configures a different Shift mapping.
AltGr+the key continues to produce an opening brace.
Other AZERTY digit-row remaps and non-AZERTY layouts remain unchanged.

confidence.rationale: The 0.97.2 report establishes a residual Shift-specific failure after an AltGr improvement, but current-build behavior and the exact virtual-key/modifier resolution path need confirmation.

issue_context.summary: Remapping one French AZERTY digit-row key to curly apostrophe reportedly overrides the Shift+key digit output, even after a later update restored AltGr behavior.
known_information: The issue lists PowerToys 0.94.1 and Windows 11 with a French AZERTY keyboard.
The target digit-row key normally produces apostrophe, 4 with Shift, and an opening brace with AltGr.
PowerToys 0.97.2 restored AltGr output for the reporter, but Shift still produces the base remapped apostrophe.
A Shift+key-specific remap reportedly has no effect.
The reporter says ZoomIt was disabled and the issue remained.
inferences: The base-key remap may be overriding modifier-dependent layout output, but the current event/key resolution path has not been traced.
issue_context.analysis: The 0.97.2 update only partially addressed the reported behavior. Keep the remaining Shift path distinct from the restored AltGr output and verify it on current stable before selecting a broader layout change.
initial_investigation: Read the body and all five comments, including the 0.97.2 partial-fix report and confirmation that ZoomIt is disabled.
No maintainer reproduction, linked fix, or active assignee is identified in the current discussion.

information_gaps.information: Whether the Shift+key override still fails on current stable and the exact current behavior of base, Shift, and AltGr variants
information_gaps.why_needed: The last concrete update is PowerToys 0.97.2 and only reports a partial improvement; current behavior determines whether the Shift path remains defective.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Repeat the same AZERTY digit-row remap on current stable and report the output for the base key, Shift+key, and AltGr+key.

reproduce.title: Check modifier outputs for a French AZERTY digit-row remap
prerequisites: Windows with a French AZERTY layout
setup: Remap the fifth digit-row key to curly apostrophe.
steps: Press the key without modifiers and record the output.
Press Shift+the key and record the output.
Press AltGr+the key and record the output.
If configured, add a separate Shift+key mapping to 4 and repeat.
reproduce.expected_result: The base remap produces curly apostrophe, Shift produces 4 unless explicitly remapped, and AltGr produces an opening brace.
